dialogues.speaker: Ematol
dialogues.text: Teeheehee! What a wonderfully executed mission! Perhaps... the Captain will allow me to write the training manual when we create a "bomb squad"!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Judging from how proudly you're talking to yourself, the mission must be going swimmingly?

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Oh! Great Honorary Knight and The Helper in White, I'm happy to report that the mission to "Annihilate the Invasive Anglers" has been completed!

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Phonia has double-checked and confirmed that I have cleared out all the Angler nests. Not a single fish slipped through our net!

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: However, there were a few nests that were quite tough. I had to use multiple bombs to get rid of them. The heavy rocks were really difficult to deal with.

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: No wonder all the Spark Knight's bombs, large or small, have such a high ratio of explosive charge to weight! It's all about ensuring sufficient detonation pressure to crack hardened targets! She is so incredible!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Great. More technobabble that we can't understand...

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: However, strictly speaking, charge quantity isn't the answer to everything. The primary issue is that explosive energy disperses in every direction and is not focused in a single direction.

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Could a cone-shaped casing be used to concentrate the explosive energy so it would penetrate thick defenses...?

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Then a cone-shaped case like that would have to be made of sturdy metal... That's something I need to research...

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Right! With the extra bonus from this operation and a week's salary, I'll treat the Spark Knight to a few grand meals to thank her for her contributions to the operation...

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: And also discuss with her how to make a type of bomb with a new structure that can focus the explosive energy... Heheheh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! It's great that you want to treat Klee to a meal, but you're the one who did all the work.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wouldn't you feel you did all that work for nothing if you just give away everything that you earned through your own hard work and time to others?

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Nothing of the sort! Everything I know about bombs, I either learned from the Spark Knight or I was inspired by her to invent it myself!

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: If the Spark Knight hadn't shown me her bombs and explained so much about them, I'd still be... a regular knight without neither strength of arm nor skill with a blade.

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: And I wouldn't have been able to complete the mission this time!

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: That's why I honestly feel the credit for the success of this mission belongs to the Spark Knight! The Spark Knight is not interested in Mora, but she's definitely into food!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: W—Wow! Such irrefutable, solid logic!

choices.text: Woohoo! The Spark Knight has a new apprentice!

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Shh! It's not like that, really!

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: The Spark Knight shall always be completely free. A bond like that between master and apprentice, that would be a constraint upon the Spark Knight! I do not wish to impose such trouble on her!

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: At most I'll just... Well... Observe the Spark Knight from afar and study how she crafts and deploys bombs...

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Right! Just treat me as a copycat bombmaker in the wild!

choices.text: Woohoo! Klee's student's going to pay for the meal!
You jumped to that topic way too quickly!

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Ematol, Weapons Specialist of the investigation team, reporting to the Great Honorary Knight and The Helper in White!

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: You may have heard of me, but since you're captain-level heroes who've seen many knights, so it's understandable if you don't remember me!

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: If you don't mind, please allow me to give you a brief introduction to some of my responsibilities in the investigation team...

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: "In addition to basic military intelligence reports, we also investigate, collect, and analyze combat-related data of the Knights, finding ways to continuously improve tactics and combat capabilities."

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Therefore, learning the habits of the Knights and modifying their weapons and equipment are both part of our responsibilities.

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: The so-called Weapons Specialist, in truth, is a knight who is responsible for testing experimental weapons.

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: I was sent to carry out the mission to "Annihilate the Invasive Anglers." I am happy to report that I have successfully eradicated all the invasive Anglers in Cider Lake, and have had the chance to test out a prototype bomb...

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: I am completely satisfied!

choices.text: So you must also be a skilled combatant?

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Not at all. I know nothing about combat. If I were to take up a sword, even a wild boar could take on twenty of me.

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: But I'm tougher than nails! Haha!

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: When I was trying to analyze the formula for Jumpy Dumpty, I went through... Let me count... 27 incidents, and the blast sent me flying in 19 of them!

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: But after bandaging myself up and applying splints, I returned to the team's garrison the next day and went back to work!

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: My colleagues were very understanding and helped me keep the incidents hidden from Captain Albedo. Otherwise, I would've missed out on work!

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Following the Sparks is not for the faint of heart or the undisciplined!

choices.text: You don't have to push yourself that hard...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now Paimon's really worried about this Knight's mental state... If we get a chance, we should ask Albedo to keep an eye on her.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Caring about nothing but your work is a bit much!

choices.text: You could've asked your Captain for some leave...
Are you also a Master of Weaponry?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (She's obviously too happy to care about anything else... Let's just leave her be...)
